verified_requirements.label: GCSE eligibility gate

stage_2_selection.summary: ARU ranks eligible applicants by UCAT cognitive total after documented percentage UCAT uplifts. WAMS may stack with one regional uplift, and Essex takes precedence over East of England. Academics are threshold-only and SJT is a filter only.

ranking_factors.label: Raw UCAT total
ranking_factors.notes: Raw UCAT 2050/2700 before any contextual or regional percentage uplift.

ranking_factors.label: Percentage UCAT uplifts

unknown_calculation_areas: Final MMI rank and offer outcomes are outside ApplySmart scope.

historical_context.warning: ARU working thresholds and historical UCAT values are interview guidance context only. They are not offer prediction.

limitations: It is not a guarantee of interview.

confidence.summary: Official ARU method evidence is available and ARU.docx supplies working-threshold context only and historical guidance data, with non-A-level routes retained as documented manual-review boundaries.

reasons: The university selection approach is implemented.

display.primary_explanation: ARU ranks eligible applicants by adjusted UCAT for interview selection. This result is interview guidance only, not an offer prediction or an interview guarantee.
display.historical_guidance_caveat: Interview thresholds may change each admissions cycle depending on applicant competition and interview capacity. Historical figures are guidance only, not a current cut-off, and do not guarantee an interview.
display.secondary_explanation: WAMS, East of England and Essex uplifts are percentage UCAT uplifts. WAMS may stack with one regional uplift; Essex takes precedence over East of England. No flat regional point values are used.
